stories.canonical_title: C++26 fails its ISO draft ballot over contracts
stories.known_facts: Reported: C++26 failed its Draft International Standard ballot, the first C++ draft to do so, according to a post summarising the official SC22 result. The draft got 12 of 20 P-member yes votes (60%, short of two-thirds) and 9 of 22 negative votes (41%, above the 25% cap); the ballot closed on 23 October 2026. It is not yet known how long the delay will be or whether contracts will be removed.

stories.canonical_title: Apple blocks 12 compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates
stories.known_facts: Confirmed: Apple is blocking 12 compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates that issue TLS certificates, after the private keys of eight intermediate CAs were compromised; eMudhra and Sectigo revoked the affected certificates. Apple says most users need do nothing, but Mac command-line tools that read /etc/ssl/cert.pem, including curl and git, may still accept them until a future update.
